# Fachmy Faiz Bentra Kabila — Full Stack Engineer

> Fachmy is a Full Stack Engineer based in Bandung, Indonesia, with six years of experience building production applications across frontend, backend, database, mobile, and cloud environments.

## Professional Profile

Fachmy builds responsive React and Next.js interfaces, C#/.NET and ASP.NET Core services, REST APIs, SQL-backed workflows, mobile applications, automated tests, and cloud deployments.

## Programming Languages

JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, C++, C, PHP, Go, Rust, Ruby, Swift, Kotlin, Dart, SQL, Scala, R, Perl, Lua, Objective-C, F#, Elixir, Erlang, Clojure, Groovy, Bash, PowerShell, Solidity, Julia, MATLAB, COBOL, Fortran, Haskell, OCaml, Pascal, VBA

## Frameworks and Platforms

React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, Express, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Flutter, Android, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, AWS, Linode, Docker, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, CI/CD, Postman, Swagger, and OpenAPI.

## Experience

- Full Stack Developer at SolarWave Technology LLC, September 2025–August 2026
- Senior Software Engineer at DPOI Solutions, January 2024–August 2025
- Software Developer at Navigate360, March 2022–December 2023
- Junior Developer at Munika Cipta Teknologi, June 2020–February 2022

## Education

Bachelor of Computer Science, Telkom University, Bandung, 2015–2019.
